title: Clo Digital Fashion Weekend 2024
description:
Check out our Digital Fashion Weekend event highlights! Discover the experiences shared by our visitors. From November 2-3rd, this event attracted hundreds of visitors eager to explore the CLO Ecosystem in Ho Chi Minh City, Vietnam.

Featuring #createwithclo works by local Vietnamese talent and highlighting our CLO Creator Collective including Stephy Fung (@stephyfung), Vesna Stawa (@orchidea3d), Patricia Nahorniac (@deadstockbloom), Greta Staude (@fashionx3d), Calvyn Justus (@calvynjustus) and Alfie Taylor (@akjt11). 

We're excited to host the next event! Share your city suggestions in the comments.

Questions? Comment below or ask in our CLO discord server: https://support.clo3d.com/hc/en-us/articles/7814962429977-How-can-I-join-CLO-Discord- 

---

transcript: Yeah, there's like parts where you could see other works from, I guess, people from Ho Chi Minh, and then you can also see clothing made from Cloth3D. I've been in Cloth3D already eight years, so one of my fashion shows on the screen now. The factories that I partner with, they use Cloth often, and I know it's a very integral part of our business. I've spoken to the merchandisers that use Cloth, and they express that obviously it helps them with more... Yeah. Time, management, efficiency, and the communication between the client and our factory is definitely a lot more seamless. Yeah. Yeah. Yeah. Yeah. Yeah.
markdown_content: ## Overview of Cloth3D Usage in Digital Fashion This section explains the role of Cloth3D software in digital fashion design, production efficiency, and communication within the fashion industry. It highlights how Cloth3D supports factories and merchandisers in managing workflows and improving collaboration. ## Experience with Cloth3D in Fashion Production The speaker has used Cloth3D for eight years, including showcasing fashion designs created with the software in fashion shows. Cloth3D is deeply integrated into their business operations and those of their partner factories. ## Benefits of Cloth3D for Factories and Merchandisers Factories partnering with the speaker frequently use Cloth3D as part of their production process. Merchandisers report that Cloth3D significantly enhances time management and operational efficiency. Additionally, the software facilitates smoother communication between clients and factories, streamlining collaboration throughout the production cycle.
